title: highlight_created
description: Operator created a highlight on a passage. State = passage context the highlight was made in. Action = the highlight's location + colour/tag.

bbox.comment: Added 2026-05-22: PDF user-space coordinates [x0,y0,x1,y1] of the highlight selection rect. Optional — pre-2026-05-22 emitters did not include it. SPR-10 sidecar visual reanchor reads this; absence falls back to text-only restore.

page.comment: Added 2026-05-22: 1-based PDF page index where the highlight sits.
